nodes.n: Thursday. 9:15 AM. Sameer hands you a teal cap. Not a training cap. The real one. There's a number stitched on the back.

nodes.t: Everybody gets a speech when they get this. Mine was twenty minutes long. I'll give you three words. Bat like Kuttanad.

choice.t: Put the cap on and say nothing.
"Nine times, Captain. Thank you for the tenth."

nodes.n: On the riverbank in Kuttanad, it's 2 PM, and nobody has gone to work. The temple has stopped ringing its bell so people can hear the commentary.
Forty-four overs gone. You came in at five, with the team wobbling. You've batted for an hour and a half. Sixty-two runs. Not one ball has been easy.
Now it's the last over. The scoreboard is very simple and very cruel.

moment.title: 12 off 6
moment.desc: Your World Cup debut. The fastest attack in the tournament. Your village is watching on a bedsheet. Twelve to win.
moment.winSub: Four hundred people on a riverbank lose their minds.
moment.loseSub: The whole stadium stands for the new boy.

nodes.n: The last ball goes high over long-on and lands in a sea of teal and orange flags.
Before you even think about it, your hand goes to your collar.
In Kuttanad, a man in a checked shirt and a white wrap-around sarong falls off the roof of his own auto-rickshaw. He is fine. He will tell the story for the rest of his life.
Two short. Brennan's last ball is a perfect yorker. You dig it out and run, and it isn't enough. Seventy-one runs, on debut, in a losing team. And yet, when you walk off, the whole stadium stands.
On the way, your hand goes to your collar. A camera catches it.
Within an hour, the clip has twelve million views. "Who is he touching his collar for?" Everyone has a theory. A girlfriend. A god. A curse.

nodes.t: Twelve million. My phone has been ringing since the last ball. Everyone wants to know who the collar is for.

choice.t: "For Shibu. My friend with the auto."
"For everyone in Kuttanad watching on a bedsheet."

choice.d: Keep the secret. Shibu will love it.

nodes.t: That's going to be the best headline I've written this year.

nodes.n: Midnight. Room 908. You can't sleep. There's a sports channel on mute. Then the ticker along the bottom of the screen changes.
"BOARD INQUIRY: Reporter Diya Nair named in leak."

nodes.cliff: The best day of your life, and Bhandari has just named Diya.
